template: Final verification of the Grafana dashboard '{{v3}}'. Open the dashboard by browsing to it (search for it in Dashboards), then report ALL of the following read from the live page: (1) the browser's current page URL exactly as shown in the address bar / window.location.href; (2) the dashboard title shown in the top bar; (3) the titles of every panel on the dashboard in order; (4) the text content of the '{{v1}} Notes' panel; (5) the data source name shown in the query editor of the '{{v1}} Availability' panel (click Edit on that panel to check, then go Back); (6) the visualization type of the '{{v1}} Availability' panel; (7) the time range shown in the top-bar time picker; (8) the auto-refresh interval shown in the top-bar refresh control; (9) the dashboard's tags (Dashboard settings > General > Tags). Do not change anything — this is read-only verification.

addedContains: - button "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"
